description: folklore is mother's cottagecore depression era and honestly?? my favorite version of her 😭✨ 'august', 'cardigan', 'my tears ricochet', the whole love triangle lore, the 'the last great american dynasty' house drama?? it's giving indie girl genius and I ate up every crumb. She went from glitter popstar to forest witch and it WORKED. This album changed me as a person, no skips, pure art 💅🔥
